title.zh: 从整体代码提升共同分解
title.en: Lifting a joint decomposition from a whole code

claim.zh: 在共同纤维紧致、表示准确且约简时，整体代码的共同分解可从该整体的任一给定原生代表提升。
claim.en: Under joint-fiber compactness and an exact reduced presentation, a code-level joint decomposition lifts from any given native representative of the whole code.

hypotheses.zh: JointCompact、Exact、Reduced；codeJoint 使用同一模型的原生 joint 关系。
hypotheses.en: JointCompact, Exact and Reduced; codeJoint uses the same model’s native joint relation.

correspondence.zh: 整体、代码与成对关系的解释是给定的，不假设所有物理实现满足紧致性。
correspondence.en: The whole/code/joint interpretation is supplied; universal physical compactness is not assumed.

detail.zh: 提升存在部分，不保证任意指定的部分可以替换或重复使用同一支持。
detail.en: Lifting provides some parts, not arbitrary substitution of designated parts or duplication of support.

limitations.zh: 提升存在部分，不保证任意指定的部分可以替换或重复使用同一支持。
limitations.en: Lifting provides some parts, not arbitrary substitution of designated parts or duplication of support.

validation_scope.zh: 复用所列既有 Lean 回执；本次仅审读源码、核对声明及回执哈希对应，未重新编译。
validation_scope.en: Credits the linked existing Lean receipt. This migration reads source and checks declaration presence and receipt hash binding; it does not rerun Lean.

next_delta.zh: 复用 code_joint_lifts_from_whole 作为递归计划的每节点接口。
next_delta.en: Reuse code_joint_lifts_from_whole as the per-node interface for recursive plans.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：迁移既有成果身份与范围；不新增定理，不移动原始资料。
history.en: 2026-10-08: migrated existing result identity and scope; no new theorem or relocated source.
